chart.name: Overall query cache hit %
chart.programText:
A = data('cache_result.qcache-hits', filter=filter('plugin', 'mysql'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cache_result.qcache-not_cached', filter=filter('plugin', 'mysql'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/(A+B)).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Top commands/sec

chart.name: Selects/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('mysql_commands.select', filter=filter('plugin', 'mysql'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')

chart.name: Mutations/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('mysql_commands.insert', filter=filter('plugin', 'mysql'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('mysql_commands.update*', filter=filter('plugin', 'mysql'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['sf_metric']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('mysql_commands.delete', filter=filter('plugin', 'mysql'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (A+B+C).publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (D).min().publish(label='E')
F = (D).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='F')
G = (D).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='G')
H = (D).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='H')
I = (D).max().publish(label='I')

chart.name: Mutations/sec 24h change %
